_about: Adjective forms (m_sg/f_sg/m_pl/f_pl, before-vowel form, feminine pronunciation). Built by scripts/build_adj_forms.py from Wiktionary (kaikki.org, CC BY-SA 4.0) + Lexique 3.83 (CC BY-SA 4.0), rules as last resort; hand fixes in curated/adj_forms_overrides.tsv. Merged into vocab.jsonl by scripts/finalize.py.

fr_arriere_noun.forms_note: As an adjective 'arrière' is invariable: les roues arrière.

fr_chatain_adj.forms_note: Usually the same for m. and f. (une femme châtain), 'châtaine' exists but is rare.

fr_demi_noun.forms_note: Before a noun it is invariable and hyphenated (une demi-heure), after a noun it agrees in gender only (deux heures et demie).

fr_mal_adv.forms_note: As an adjective (c'est mal, pas mal) 'mal' never changes.

fr_standard_noun.forms_note: Usually invariable in gender (une taille standard), plural agreement (des tailles standard/standards) varies.
